items.title: Barclays cutting 5,000 jobs as it increases reliance on AI
items.summary: The bank says it is using more AI leading to a 5% reduction in its workforce.

items.title: 1800s law must be updated to protect 'backbone' of UK - MP
items.summary: An inadequate law from the 19th century must be strengthened to deter saboteurs from attacking the UK's critical undersea cables and pipelines, a minister has said.

items.title: UK's gaps in Arctic defence leave it open to Russian attacks, committee warns
items.summary: A report by MPs urges the UK to address capability gaps including a lack of Royal Navy warships and submarines, as Russia seeks to dominate the region.

items.title: Barclays cutting 5,000 jobs in AI-led efficiency drive
items.summary: Barclays has revealed it is cutting 5,000 jobs - 5% of its workforce - as part of efforts to save costs and drive efficiency through investment in artificial intelligence (AI).

items.title: Diabetes and ADHD drugs to be tested on Alzheimer's patients in new study
items.summary: Drugs will be tested simultaneously, which it's hoped will speed up the process of finding new treatments for this common type of dementia.

items.title: North Korea plans to resume propaganda broadcasts along border with South Korea
items.summary: North Korea says it plans to resume propaganda broadcasts targeting South Korea within days along the heavily-armed border between the two countries.
